description: Windows server data sources commonly ingested by ServiceNow Discovery patterns. Covers WMI, registry, PowerShell, and performance counters. Most patterns target the root\cimv2 namespace.

data_points.name: Win32_OperatingSystem
data_points.description: Operating system metadata: caption, version, build, install date, last boot, total memory, hostname.
data_points.typical_ci: cmdb_ci_win_server: os, os_version, os_service_pack, ram, last_discovered
data_points.example_query: SELECT Caption, Version, BuildNumber, OSArchitecture, InstallDate, LastBootUpTime, TotalVisibleMemorySize, FreePhysicalMemory, CSName FROM Win32_OperatingSystem

data_points.name: Win32_ComputerSystem
data_points.description: Hardware/system identification: hostname, manufacturer, model, domain, NumberOfProcessors, TotalPhysicalMemory.
data_points.typical_ci: cmdb_ci_win_server: name, manufacturer, model_id, dns_domain, cpu_count
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, Manufacturer, Model, Domain, DomainRole, NumberOfProcessors, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, TotalPhysicalMemory, SystemType, UserName, BootupState FROM Win32_ComputerSystem

data_points.name: Win32_BIOS
data_points.description: BIOS/firmware: serial number, manufacturer, version, release date.
data_points.example_query: SELECT SerialNumber, Manufacturer, Version, ReleaseDate, SMBIOSBIOSVersion FROM Win32_BIOS

data_points.name: Win32_Processor
data_points.description: CPU details: name, family, manufacturer, MaxClockSpeed, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors. One row per CPU.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, Manufacturer, Family, MaxClockSpeed, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, ProcessorId, Architecture FROM Win32_Processor

data_points.name: Win32_PhysicalMemory
data_points.description: RAM modules: capacity, speed, manufacturer, part number, slot. One row per DIMM.
data_points.example_query: SELECT BankLabel, Capacity, Speed, Manufacturer, PartNumber, DeviceLocator, SerialNumber FROM Win32_PhysicalMemory

data_points.name: Win32_LogicalDisk
data_points.description: Logical disks (volumes): drive letter, file system, size, free space.
data_points.example_query: SELECT DeviceID, FileSystem, Size, FreeSpace, VolumeName, VolumeSerialNumber, DriveType FROM Win32_LogicalDisk WHERE DriveType=3

data_points.name: Win32_DiskDrive
data_points.description: Physical disks: model, serial, size, interface type, partitions.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Model, SerialNumber, Size, InterfaceType, MediaType, Partitions, DeviceID FROM Win32_DiskDrive

data_points.name: Win32_NetworkAdapter
data_points.description: Network interfaces: name, MAC, speed, manufacturer. Filter PhysicalAdapter=TRUE for real NICs.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, MACAddress, Speed, Manufacturer, NetConnectionID, AdapterType FROM Win32_NetworkAdapter WHERE PhysicalAdapter=TRUE

data_points.name: Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration
data_points.description: Network adapter IP config: IPAddress, IPSubnet, DefaultIPGateway, DNSServerSearchOrder, DHCPEnabled.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Description, MACAddress, IPAddress, IPSubnet, DefaultIPGateway, DNSServerSearchOrder, DHCPEnabled FROM Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration WHERE IPEnabled=TRUE

data_points.name: Win32_Service
data_points.description: Windows services: name, display name, state (Running/Stopped), start mode, run-as account, executable path.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, DisplayName, State, StartMode, StartName, PathName, ProcessId, Status FROM Win32_Service

data_points.name: Win32_Process
data_points.description: Running processes: name, PID, command line, working set size, creation date.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CommandLine, ExecutablePath, WorkingSetSize, CreationDate FROM Win32_Process

data_points.name: Win32_Product
data_points.description: Installed software (MSI-installed only — incomplete; use registry path for full inventory). NAME/VERSION/VENDOR.
data_points.typical_ci: cmdb_ci_spkg: name, version, vendor (Software Asset Management)
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, Version, Vendor, InstallDate, IdentifyingNumber FROM Win32_Product

data_points.name: Win32_QuickFixEngineering
data_points.description: Installed Windows Updates (KB hotfixes).
data_points.example_query: SELECT HotFixID, Description, InstalledOn FROM Win32_QuickFixEngineering

data_points.name: Win32_Share
data_points.description: SMB shares.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, Path, Description, Type FROM Win32_Share

data_points.name: MSCluster_Cluster
data_points.description: Windows Failover Cluster info. Namespace: root\MSCluster.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, FQDN FROM MSCluster_Cluster

data_points.name: MSCluster_Node
data_points.description: Cluster nodes. Namespace: root\MSCluster.
data_points.example_query: SELECT Name, NodeName, State FROM MSCluster_Node

data_points.name: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion
data_points.description: OS version registry — used as a fallback when WMI is restricted. ProductName, CurrentVersion, BuildLab, ReleaseId, EditionID.
data_points.example_query: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProductName

data_points.name: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
data_points.description: Installed software inventory (32-bit + 64-bit). More complete than Win32_Product. Iterate subkeys; each has DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate.
data_points.example_query: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* (also \Wow6432Node\...)

data_points.name: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services
data_points.description: Service definitions (more detail than Win32_Service for ImagePath, dependencies).
data_points.example_query: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<service_name>\ImagePath

data_points.name: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Microsoft SQL Server\Instance Names\SQL
data_points.description: SQL Server instance names — used by SQL discovery patterns to enumerate installed instances.
data_points.example_query: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Microsoft SQL Server\Instance Names\SQL\<InstanceName>

data_points.name: Get-ComputerInfo
data_points.description: Modern PowerShell cmdlet replacing many WMI queries. Returns OS, BIOS, CS, hardware in one call.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object CsName,OsName,OsVersion,WindowsVersion,WindowsBuildLabEx,CsManufacturer,CsModel,BiosSeralNumber,CsTotalPhysicalMemory"

data_points.name: Get-Service
data_points.description: PowerShell service enumeration. Lighter than WMI for simple status checks.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-Service | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType"

data_points.name: Get-NetAdapter
data_points.description: PowerShell network adapter info — replaces Win32_NetworkAdapter for Server 2012+.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name,InterfaceDescription,Status,MacAddress,LinkSpeed"

data_points.name: Get-NetIPAddress
data_points.description: PowerShell IP address listing.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-NetIPAddress | Where-Object AddressFamily -eq IPv4 | Select-Object IPAddress,PrefixLength,InterfaceAlias"

data_points.name: Get-Process
data_points.description: PowerShell process listing. Pair with -IncludeUserName for run-as info.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-Process | Select-Object Name,Id,Path,Company,ProductVersion"

data_points.name: Get-WindowsFeature
data_points.description: Server roles + features inventory (Server 2012+).
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-WindowsFeature | Where-Object InstallState -eq Installed | Select-Object Name,DisplayName"

data_points.name: Get-Hotfix
data_points.description: Installed Windows updates. PowerShell wrapper around Win32_QuickFixEngineering.
data_points.example_query: powershell -Command "Get-Hotfix | Select-Object HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn"

data_points.name: ipconfig /all
data_points.description: Classic IP config — fallback when PowerShell/WMI restricted.
data_points.example_query: ipconfig /all

data_points.name: systeminfo
data_points.description: Comprehensive system info text dump. Often used as a fallback when WMI is denied.
data_points.example_query: systeminfo

data_points.name: tasklist /v
data_points.description: Process listing with run-as user.
data_points.example_query: tasklist /v /fo csv

data_points.name: netstat -ano
data_points.description: TCP/UDP listening + established ports with PIDs. Used to map services to processes.
data_points.example_query: netstat -ano

data_points.name: \Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time
data_points.description: CPU utilization performance counter.
data_points.example_query: typeperf "\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time" -sc 1

data_points.name: \Memory\Available MBytes
data_points.description: Free memory in MB.
data_points.example_query: typeperf "\Memory\Available MBytes" -sc 1
